observations: The second Split-related caller candidate loads the 0.001 double into XMM6 and passes it in XMM2 to 0x14032a500 at 0x14067bbd0.

The retained Ghidra instruction list has no intervening XMM6 writes between the load and comparison, though the code paths and the indirect function's semantics are not established.
interpretation: This supports a separate comparison involving the constant on an alternate Split-related candidate path. It does not establish a 0.001 mm point-search radius or the path used by the scaled fixture.
